dialogue.text: Not bad, Starlight. You've definitely got your mother's ear for a melody.
Heh! Told ya! Guess that makes you the... second-best artist in the family?
Don't get ahead of yourself. I'm still the one signing the cheques.
Psh, details, details! Come on, run it back! I'm on a roll!
Fine. But let's switch it up. This one... is for your mother.
Aww... pops! Okay, okay! For Mum! Let's do this!
